_source: LIVE capture, POST https://ash.backoffice.dutchie.com/api/posv3/user/EmployeeLogin with a username that does not exist, 2026-08-07. Probed with a nonexistent user ON PURPOSE — a wrong password against the real service account risks a lockout that would take the store's POS down.
_note_status: HTTP **200**. Not 401. This is the exact shape the old login_employee turned into a truthy ('', '', 0) tuple, so the vulnerability it replaced was live, not theoretical.
_note_password_echo: Data ECHOES THE SUBMITTED PASSWORD BACK. Nothing on the login path may ever log a Dutchie response body.
